name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: B2B Marketing Copywriter & Content Strategist
summary: B2B marketing copywriter and content strategist with 15+ years across SaaS, MarTech, and agency environments, translating evolving brand voice and value propositions into clear, compelling, conversion-focused copy. Writes across the full B2B stack — website pages, sales collateral, campaigns, and paid media (LinkedIn, Google Ads) — with a lead-generation mindset and fluency communicating value to executive and technical buyers. Reliable, low-oversight independent contributor who brings a strong point of view, thoughtful pushback, and fresh creative perspective to lean, collaborative teams.
